claims.quote: Fictional Store Moss dispatches paid orders within two working days after payment confirmation. The stated dispatch promise excludes preordered goods.
Moss accepts unopened goods for return within ten calendar days when the customer provides a receipt. Personalized goods are excluded from this return policy.
Moss pays return postage for goods damaged in transit if photographs were recorded on delivery. The documents do not state who pays postage for a change-of-mind return.
Moss holds pickup orders for three working days after the ready notice. Collection after that period requires a written extension; without it the order is cancelled.

value.criterion: Assess each assurance using all four documents. Preserve the preordered-goods exclusion, receipt and unopened-item conditions, the photograph condition for postage, the written-extension rule, and any unstated change-of-mind cost.
value.statement: Taken together, the four documents do not verify the proposed assurances. Dispatch: the documented promise is within two working days after payment confirmation, excluding preordered goods—not a guarantee of next-working-day dispatch for every paid order. Returns: the assurance about personalized goods contradicts their explicit exclusion. The policy accepts unopened goods within ten calendar days when a receipt is provided, subject to that exclusion. Postage: payment for every return is unsupported; Moss pays return postage for goods damaged in transit if photographs were recorded on delivery. Responsibility for change-of-mind return postage and its cost are unstated, so neither free returns nor a customer charge can be inferred. Pickup: indefinite holding without written approval contradicts the three-working-day holding period after the ready notice. Collection beyond that period requires a written extension; without one, the order is cancelled.
value.uncertainty: Change-of-mind return postage responsibility and cost are unstated. The dispatch policy does not guarantee next-working-day dispatch or establish a dispatch deadline for preordered goods.
